item.title: UK announces new sanctions against West Bank settlement firms
item.body: The UK has announced new sanctions on firms building illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Foreign secretary Ed Miliband had previously pledged to respond to the expansion of the settlements.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🌍 UK announces new sanctions against West Bank settlement firms

The UK has announced new sanctions on firms building illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Foreign secretary Ed Miliband had previously pledged to respond to the expansion of the settlements.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 17 November, 10:50
